findings.claim: The test helper `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` ignores its `value` argument and hard-codes the occurrence id, and `IssueOccurrence.__eq__` compares only id. As a result, all mock occurrences compare equal, and tests cannot detect wrong group_key, value or priority passed to `build_occurrence_and_event_data`.

verifier.reason: In tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py (patch lines 458-489), `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` never uses `value` and always sets `id="eb4b0acffadb4d098d48cb14165ab578"`, and src/sentry/issues/issue_occurrence.py:181-184 compares only `id`, so fingerprint and priority differences go unnoticed. The tests show this: `test_results_on_change` builds the expected occurrence with 6 when the real value is 100, multi_group expects 6 for group_2 (real value 10), and `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe` uses "val1" against "group_key", yet all of them would pass.
